packageRules.description: Track meshtastic/protobufs submodule and link the diff in PR bodies. The SDK owns Wire codegen for atak.proto (issue #6) so submodule bumps land here first, then Renovate-bumps the SDK release in downstream consumers. Weekly schedule: upstream commits near-daily (~12 digest PRs in June/July 2026) but atak.proto rarely changes; a weekly batch keeps the submodule fresh without the churn.

Hold typescript at <7 until a stable typedoc supports it. typedoc 0.28.x peer-requires typescript 5.x-6.0.x and only 1.0.0-dev prereleases target 7.x, so the ts7 PR can never go green (npm ERESOLVE). Drop this rule when typedoc 1.0 ships.
